import urllib.request
import urllib.parse
import json

headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'}

def search_query(q, limit=20, offset=0):
    url = f"https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&generator=search&gsrnamespace=6&gsrsearch={urllib.parse.quote(q)}&gsrlimit={limit}&gsroffset={offset}&prop=imageinfo&iiprop=url|size|mime&iiurlwidth=600&format=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
            pages = data.get('query', {}).get('pages', {})
            return len(pages), list(pages.keys())
    except Exception as e:
        return -1, str(e)

categories = [
    ("全部视频 (All)", "filetype:video"),
    ("自然风光 (Nature)", "filetype:video nature"),
    ("延时摄影 (Timelapse)", "filetype:video timelapse"),
    ("动画短片 (Animation)", "filetype:video animation"),
    ("科学实验 (Science)", "filetype:video science"),
    ("宇宙天文 (Astronomy)", "filetype:video astronomy"),
    ("野生动物 (Wildlife)", "filetype:video wildlife"),
    ("水下海洋 (Underwater)", "filetype:video underwater"),
    ("航空飞行 (Aviation)", "filetype:video aviation"),
    ("精选视频 (deepcat)", "filetype:video deepcat:Featured_videos")
]

for name, q in categories:
    cnt1, _ = search_query(q, limit=20, offset=0)
    cnt2, _ = search_query(q, limit=20, offset=20)
    print(f"{name:25} | Q: {q:35} | Page 1: {cnt1} | Page 2: {cnt2}")
